chain.label: Corrosion pits and fatigue cracking in stress-redistribution holes of 7th stage HPC disk
chain.trigger: fatigue cracking originated from numerous pits in the hole wall and progressed radially inboard ... from SR hole "1"

chain.label: THY repair station lacked process sheets and adequate step-by-step overhaul recordkeeping
chain.trigger: The lack of an adequate recordkeeping system and the failure to use “process sheets” to document the step-by-step overhaul/inspection procedures contributed to the failure to detect the crack

chain.label: THY failed to perform a proper inspection of the 7th stage disk during the 1991 overhaul; pits plated over and ~12 mm crack left undetected
chain.trigger: the failure of Turk Hava Yollari maintenance and inspection personnel to perform a proper inspection of a 7th stage high compressor disk

caused_by.evidence: detailed documentation ... would have increased the likelihood that the disk would have received a proper inspection and that the crack would have been detected

chain.label: Uncontained rupture of the right engine 7th stage HPC disk early in the takeoff roll
chain.trigger: reaching an indicated airspeed of about 31 knots when the right engine EPR decreased from about 1.57 to about 0.91 within 1 second

caused_by.evidence: This combined fatigue crack length is consistent with a critical crack length expected to produce separation of the disk under normal operating conditions
thus allowing the detectable crack to grow to a length at which the disk ruptured, under normal operating conditions, propelling engine fragments into the fuselage

chain.label: Engine fragment penetrated the fuselage and severed the right engine main fuel line, spraying fuel into the cabin
chain.trigger: A 6-inch section of the fuel line was severed where it passed through the aft lavatory sidewall ... Pressurized fuel sprayed into the cabin near the aft lavatory

caused_by.evidence: As a result of the uncontained failure, engine shrapnel penetrated the fuselage, severing the right engine main fuel line

chain.label: Cabin fire ignited by sparks from steel fragments and rapidly engulfed the cabin
chain.trigger: was most likely ignited by sparks generated by steel engine fragments contacting steel galley equipment in the cabin

caused_by.evidence: the fragments severed the right engine main fuel line, which resulted in a fire that rapidly engulfed the cabin area

chain.label: Loss of Emergency DC Bus power disabled the PA system and left emergency cabin lighting unpowered, delaying the evacuation order
chain.trigger: The pilot's first attempt to order an evacuation was not successful because electrical power to the PA system was lost when the engines were shut down

caused_by.evidence: After the captain stopped the airplane and the engines were shut down, he attempted to communicate to the passengers using the PA system but was unable to do so

chain.label: Aft flight attendant wearing shorts and short-sleeved shirt, leaving arms and legs uncovered
chain.trigger: She was wearing shorts and a short-sleeved polo shirt

chain.label: Takeoff rejected, airplane stopped on runway 27R and evacuated
chain.trigger: the takeoff was rejected ... The airplane was stopped on the runway, and the captain ordered the evacuation of the airplane

caused_by.evidence: the flightcrew of a following airplane reported to the ValuJet crew that the right engine was on fire, and the takeoff was rejected
the other flight attendant successfully opened the cockpit door with her own key and informed the flightcrew of the fire. The captain then ordered an evacuation
Passengers reported that during the evacuation, the emergency floor track lighting illuminated briefly but then extinguished

chain.label: One flight attendant seriously injured by shrapnel and burns; one flight attendant and five passengers minor injuries
chain.trigger: The flight attendant seated in the aft flight attendant jumpseat received serious puncture wounds from shrapnel and thermal injuries

caused_by.evidence: Unidentified pieces of the airplane debris were removed from the flight attendant's leg by medical personnel
The aft flight attendant sustained second degree burns on her legs
Had she been wearing attire similar to that recommended in “Fly Smart,” she may not have been burned
Five passengers sustained minor lacerations and contusions during the evacuation
